cards.card_text: They poisoned his food with gall and gave him vinegar to quench his thirst.
cards.verse_text: They poisoned my food with gall and gave me vinegar to quench my thirst.
cards.snippet: They poisoned my food with gall and gave me vinegar to quench my thirst.

cards.card_text: Then he says, "Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall." The wormwood shows up again, and I think that bitterness is still with him.
cards.verse_text: Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall.
cards.snippet: Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall.

cards.card_text: There they offer Jesus wine to drink, mixed with gall, and He tastes it.
cards.verse_text: And when they came to a place called Golgotha, which means The Place of the Skull, they offered Him wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, He refused to drink it.
cards.snippet: …Place of the Skull, they offered Him wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, He refused to drink it.

cards.card_text: Jesus tastes the wine mixed with gall, and then He drinks it.
cards.verse_text: they offered Him wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, He refused to drink it.
cards.snippet: they offered Him wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, He refused to drink it.
